objective: Make BUKLOD Main Wall music picker compact, scrub immediately and smoothly, confirm clip in-place and allow independent original-video/music volume together without changing media file or sponsored ads.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main source SHA 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f inspected and isolated on dev/wall-music-scrub-mix-20261123. This is source ancestry only, NOT verified on-device, live Supabase migration, released RC or OTA. Existing production, ads, points, privacy and all other features left untouched.
chosenApproach: Rebalance the height of the existing picker; render drag position locally and queue bounded seeks while dragging, commit segment only on release and approve with fixed footer action. Use one existing shared expo-audio Wall player and existing expo-video player; mix outputs with independent 0..1 volumes, lazily mount composer video preview, persist two nullable per-post columns under original post-creative RLS; legacy null volumes fall back to 100%. Preserve Marites picker with optional props. No new native package or transcoding.
selectionRationale: Separate streamed catalog music and original video audio avoids duplicate uploads or native package rebuild, limits memory use and preserves approved songs, media authorization, fixed 30-second clip, offscreen pause, ads and playback resource ownership.
alternativeApproaches: Server-side transcoding of merged MP4 per post (rejected due cost, storage and rights)
Rendering video/music players for every offscreen feed card (rejected due bandwidth, device and audio focus)
Rewriting feed/video engine or replacing audio focus manager (rejected due ad, fullscreen and PTT regression risk)
acceptanceChecks: Bottom song list remains visibly larger and row preview selection does not exit picker
Dragging updates local waveform instantly and requests bounded seeks while the 30s loop plays; exact segment saved on release
Use this 30s segment confirms directly from the editor without reselecting track
Composer independent music/video volume controls can produce concurrent audible output without re-encoding original video
Post and fullscreen use stored nullable volumes; existing posts with null volumes still play unchanged
No audio continuing after post scroll-away, tab blur, new video/ad slide, preview close or failed URL
Existing Marites picker still compiles without new props
New nullable columns must be applied/verified on authorized Supabase BEFORE any client querying them; no direct production application
Focused tests, full TS/Android/Expo compile, ads/PTT/navigation regression and on-device verification required before RC and OTA
preserveBehaviors: Audience-scoped post visibility, author-only creative writes and Supabase RLS policies unchanged; no arbitrary audio upload
One shared Wall music player, signed music URL caching, 30s clip timing, weak-network cleanup and strict offscreen lifecycle
Unmodified paid and AdMob ad rendering, IMA playback, first-view fill, scroll/route instant navigation and sponsorship eligibility
PTT, DZAS radio, calls, Marites full-view-only soundtrack and existing audio focus ownership preserved
Existing historical posts/media, rank, points, payouts and legacy nullable music data remain valid
Production source/OTA and runtime versions unchanged; migrations never applied by source branch
